scope: public read-only QA evidence from Tradernet, TakeProfit, and OpenAI surfaces

findings.title: Late hero discovery materially contributes to mobile LCP
findings.claim: Late discovery of the exact hero resource is a material contributor to the measured mobile LCP.

causal_memory.state_scope: exact hero URL and throttled Chrome profile

user_control.user_effect: The main visual signal arrives late and the page does not explain the delay.

findings.minimal_fix: Expose the correct responsive LCP image in initial HTML and mark the exact resource high priority.
findings.regression_test: Repeat three paired baseline/treatment mobile runs and assert the exact hero starts before 1 second without increasing script bytes or long-task time.

findings.title: The language redirect is not the dominant LCP cause
findings.claim: The language redirect is the dominant cause of the approximately 12-second LCP.

causal_memory.surface_scope: tradernet root and direct Russian URL

user_control.user_effect: No additional user-control loss is assigned to the rejected dominant-cause claim.

findings.minimal_fix: Keep redirect removal as lower-priority cleanup and do not present it as the LCP root cause.
findings.regression_test: Preserve the paired direct-versus-redirect experiment as negative causal memory.

findings.title: ChartStore required-field validation recurs in changed form
findings.claim: The historical ChartStore initialization defect family remains present with different missing required fields.

causal_memory.state_scope: public indicator page and prior manual audit family
causal_memory.time_scope: January 2026 manual audit to workflow run 29661982911

user_control.user_effect: The console regression is confirmed; visible chart corruption or decision impact was not established in this public run.

findings.minimal_fix: Provide schema-complete ChartStore defaults and fail initialization with one bounded, visible error state.
findings.regression_test: Open the published indicator and assert no required-field errors plus a visible initialized chart state.

findings.title: OpenAI homepage is a repeated lab LCP outlier
findings.claim: Under the bounded mobile laboratory profile, the OpenAI homepage repeatedly paints its LCP at approximately 63 to 65 seconds.

causal_memory.state_scope: bounded mobile lab profiles; not field performance

user_control.user_effect: A visitor waits for the principal visual state without a clear explanation of whether content is still loading.

findings.minimal_fix: Treat the homepage LCP path as a dedicated performance budget with exact responsive-resource evidence.
findings.regression_test: Run the bounded mobile profile three times and fail when median LCP exceeds the agreed public-page budget.

findings.title: The historical w=750 asset cannot yet be published as the current exact LCP cause
findings.claim: The exact w=750 image remains the current mobile LCP resource and optimizing or preloading it explains the measured improvement.

causal_memory.state_scope: 390x844 DPR 1 profile versus prior Lighthouse profile

user_control.user_effect: Publishing the wrong exact resource as root cause could direct engineering effort away from the resource actually selected by the browser.

findings.minimal_fix: Repin the experiment to the currently selected w=640 resource and rerun paired baseline/preload and baseline/optimized-asset treatments.
findings.regression_test: Require at least two of three baseline LCP entries to match the pinned exact resource before a causal verdict can leave ESCALATE.

findings.title: Client-side JavaScript cost recurs across OpenAI public surfaces
findings.claim: Unused JavaScript and boot-time work are recurring contributors across the audited OpenAI public surfaces, without proving one shared root cause for every surface.

causal_memory.state_scope: one passive Lighthouse navigation per exact target

user_control.user_effect: Long main-thread or boot work can delay when public information becomes inspectable or interactive.

findings.minimal_fix: Route-split, defer, or remove JavaScript only after preserving surface-specific evidence and budgets.
findings.regression_test: Track per-surface script bytes, unused bytes, boot time, TBT, and LCP without collapsing different runtimes into one score.

findings.title: Status-page semantics can reduce access to service-state information
findings.claim: The audited status page contains accessibility and semantic findings that can make current service-state information harder to inspect for some users.

observed_findings: list item without a list parent

causal_memory.state_scope: passive Lighthouse accessibility and SEO audit

user_control.user_effect: Users relying on assistive technology or low-contrast presentation may have less reliable access to the current service state.

findings.minimal_fix: Correct semantic roles, accessible names, list structure, contrast, and page metadata while preserving incident content.
findings.regression_test: Run automated accessibility checks and keyboard/screen-reader smoke tests against the exact status-page state.
